03 / Black Line
REFERENCE 4571.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 006
Art direction: Clean editorial framing and restrained black, off-white and natural skin tones.
Original adult East Asian woman in a vertical mid torso fashion portrait, long glossy black hair in a
low side ponytail flowing over one shoulder, loose strands around temples, minimalist black
strapless top, pale gray seamless studio background, soft frontal diffusion, slight jawline shadows,
neutral expression, editorial hair campaign, photorealism, no text.
04 / Frostbound
REFERENCE 4572.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 007
Art direction: Cool backlight, jewel-toned costume, crystalline depth, silver highlights. Treat the
costume as fantasy styling rather than a historical reproduction.
Cinematic vertical portrait of an original adult woman with long chestnut waves wearing a richly
embroidered indigo and frost blue fantasy gown, translucent long sleeves, high collar, silver
pendant and delicate earrings. Tall ice crystal formations in a softly blurred background, luminous
cool directional lighting, blue highlights and subtle silver sparkle, composed direct gaze,
photorealistic fantasy costume editorial, fine film grain, no lettering.
